items.coder_A: high_grade_glioma_unspecified (uncertain: WHO grade IV glioma eligible without IDH requirement; mixed_glioma_gbm_named possible)
items.reason: Inclusion: 'The resected recurrent gliomas was identified as WHO III~IV Glioma by histologic pathology'. Grade 4 is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement and glioblastoma is never named, so R7 applies: include as historical glioblastoma.

note: EARLY_PHASE1 (phase 0/1), so translational subset only. Candidate follows D30-R8/C13 (consistent with D31-B12): the drugs are chosen per patient by PTC drug screen and tumour board, and the record says 'FDA-approved chemotherapeutic or targeted drugs', so unspecified_approved_panel. Caveat: the arm says 'all the FDA-approved drugs that have been used in treating gliomas', which may in practice be mostly established GBM therapies (temozolomide, lomustine, bevacizumab). R8 does not distinguish this case. The priority-3 cns5 disagreement resolves to historical under R7. No D31 convention changes any value; nothing pending for XL.
